digest.component_or_area: tickets branch push delivery on async/library/MCP paths
propositions: A failed tickets push on async, library, and MCP paths leaves no observable signal (stderr discarded, no handler installed, agent reads only tool result) while the synchronous CLI path reports it, causing two commits to strand invisibly.

The approved remedy records push-delivery failures as a durable marker in the git dir and surfaces it via rebar.push_status() for libraries, a push_status field on MCP write-tool results, and polling for the detached async child, making all three limbs observable without changing exit codes or raising exceptions.

The marker is recorded unconditionally at the single _raise_if_strict choke point carrying all terminal-failure reasons, cleared on successful push, and placed in the git dir not the working tree to preserve byte-identical git status on failed push and follow linked worktree gitdir pointers.

Non-failure reasons (push-disabled, async-delivery-unobservable, remote-not-found, invalid-destination) are not recorded to avoid alarm fatigue in local-only stores; commit-phase and recovery reasons are recorded because a write never reaching the remote is invisible without the signal.

Ten MCP write tools (comment, edit, link, unlink, tag, untag, archive, compact _ticket/s, set_file_impact, set_verify_commands) migrate to a shared WriteAckOut {result, push_status} as a strict superset of the existing {result: str} contract; declare_no_file_impact is excluded due to structured_output=False.
